shortDescription: Thailand plans to ban exports and transit shipments of chemicals used in rare-earth mining after elevated arsenic levels were detected in rivers in the country’s north, Bloomberg reported. The country will work with China and Myanmar to address the pollution.

title: Thailand Plans Export, Transit Ban on Rare-Earth Mining Chemicals
